limitations: No additional training or inference was executed. Original independent-eval metrics are reloaded from raw TensorBoard; native eval metrics and resume provenance are reloaded from tracker/scalars/log. The online native eval model-state comparison has no separate terminal eval weight .pt and is bound to its own unchanged best checkpoint and explicit resume log.

Both implementations were run with deterministic=true, cudnn.deterministic=true, benchmark=false, and CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8. Main default benchmark=true/nondeterministic behavior was not tested here.

The archive original Stats(dim=1) was recomputed on sequential complete train batches of 250. Its full-precision mean/std were saved as native-data/<dataset>/stats.yaml and read by the current DataFactory. No-profile fallback normalization constants or automatic Stats recomputation by DataFactory were not tested.
Only seed 0 and the current main 60-step recipe were tested. This does not establish the historical README PNG 80000-step target or other seeds/hyperparameters.

GPU allocated/reserved peaks are this process Torch allocator counters, not total device memory or allocations outside Torch. Wall time was measured with concurrent historical workloads and is not an algorithm benchmark.

The CPU audit reloaded saved artifacts without another training or inference execution. The terminal native independent-eval model had no separate weight snapshot; its online comparison is bound to the audited own-best checkpoint, explicit resume log, and tracker metrics.

Raw training/eval artifacts remain under .tmp and are not distributed with a Git clone. This formal JSON preserves the actual comparison, preparation, environment, source provenance, and full-precision values.
